Training picker (data-testid=training-picker) lists TODAY's 2 sessions from GET /api/fittest/my-trainings-today: 'Strength · 07:30' (60min RPE6 Load360) and 'Conditioning · 17:30' (45min RPE7 Load315), each as training-option-<id>. Initially both selectable, first-open pre-selected with orange highlight + ✓. Recovery-summary hidden while post-type=training_checkin. POST FLOW 1: selected Strength session, uploaded /tmp/test1.jpg (800x600 random RGB), Publish succeeded (info toast 'This training check-in has already been counted for The Fittest.' because Lucas already had max 1 training point today from iter29 — expected per spec). You can still post it.' — matches spec exactly. No console errors during flows; only cosmetic Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warnings.

issues: Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — accessibility a11y warning, non-blocking.

Sonner toast after publish overlays the floating open-create-post-btn (FAB) for ~5s, preventing rapid reopen of modal. Consider auto-reopening the modal after publish or positioning the toast so it does not intercept the FAB.

critical_code_review_comments: CreatePostModal fetches /fittest/my-trainings-today only in useEffect on mount — after publishing, the modal closes; on next mount it correctly re-fetches with the 'posted' flag flipped. Good.

Publish button correctly disables when wantsTraining && !selectedTraining. When all sessions are posted the picker leaves selectedTraining pointing at a posted id (from initial pre-select) but the button stays disabled because the user cannot re-click a posted option; however selectedTraining state still holds the posted id. Consider clearing selectedTraining when the current selection becomes 'posted' to avoid a stale state, and ideally show an inline hint like 'All of today's sessions have been posted.'
DialogContent lacks a Description/aria-describedby — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to silence a11y warning and improve screen reader support.
